ls_conclusion: SHAP's lead in the deletion test therefore does not depend on LIME's kernel width or representation.
pos_conclusion: Ranking by sign does not reverse the comparison in any combination.
TON_mcn_conclusion: Pooled over seeds the counterfactuals beat the benign-donor control on UNSW-NB15, but per seed the difference is significant in 2 of 3 seeds, so it should be read as a consistent tendency rather than a robust per-model effect.
UNSW_mcn_conclusion: With the pairing used, the counterfactuals beat the benign-donor control in every seed on UNSW-NB15.
hp_note: These tests come from a second run of the hardening experiment with the same seeds, which stores the per-record outcomes; it reproduces the evasion rates above for the original and counterfactual models exactly, and those of the two controls to within 0.7 points.
